canonical_project: MTN Uganda data centre network (Mutundwe and regional sites)
notes: MTN Uganda official page describes its data-centre services and states MTN operates the largest commercial data-centre footprint in Uganda: 6 data centres spread across Central, Eastern, Western and Southern regions with total capacity of 972 racks. Methodology pass confirms the Mutundwe switch/data centre was commissioned in 2012 and houses MTN data servers. Exact addresses of the regional sites are not disclosed on the page.
